title: Application Gateway Overview
description: Learn how Azure Application Gateway provides layer-7 load balancing, SSL termination, and path-based routing.

data.text: Azure Application Gateway is a layer-7 (HTTP/HTTPS) load balancer. Unlike the layer-4 Load Balancer, it understands HTTP content. It can route requests based on URL path, host headers, or query strings.
Application Gateway also terminates SSL, so your backend servers handle plain HTTP, reducing their CPU load.

data.title: Application Gateway Features
items: SSL termination — HTTPS offload at the gateway
Path-based routing — route /api/* to one pool, /static/* to another
Host-based routing — route api.example.com and web.example.com differently
Web Application Firewall (WAF) — protect against common exploits

data.title: Create an Application Gateway with Path-Based Routing
data.content: Route /api traffic to an API pool and all other traffic to a web pool.
data.code:
# Create the Application Gateway
az network application-gateway create   --name myAppGw   --resource-group myRG   --location eastus   --capacity 2   --sku Standard_v2   --vnet-name myVNet   --subnet appgw-subnet   --frontend-port 443   --http-settings-port 80   --http-settings-protocol Http   --routing-rule-type PathBasedRouting

# Add a path-based rule
az network application-gateway rule create   --gateway-name myAppGw   --resource-group myRG   --name api-rule   --http-listener http-listener   --rule-type PathBasedRouting   --url-paths /api/*

data.caption: Application Gateway routing traffic by URL path.
data.definition:
flowchart TB
    Client["Client (HTTPS)"] --> AG["Application Gateway"]
    AG -->|"/api/*"| ApiPool["API Backend Pool"]
    AG -->|"/*"| WebPool["Web Backend Pool"]
    ApiPool --> ApiServer["API Servers"]
    WebPool --> WebServer["Web Servers"]

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Application Gateway is layer-7 and understands HTTP.
Path-based routing lets one gateway serve multiple apps.
data.takeaway: Use Application Gateway when you need HTTP-aware routing, SSL offload, or WAF protection.
